headline: Chinese humanoid robot maker UBTECH and carmaker FAW Volkswagen have agreed to test humanoid robots carrying and sorting parts inside car factories.
score_reason: Fresh agreement but a pilot with no quantities, dates or results disclosed.
importance_line: Car-plant workers may eventually work beside humanoid robots, but the deal is a test and no deployment numbers or dates were given.
source: Humanoids Daily, as relayed by Mjengo Hub
summary: Mjengo Hub, relaying a Humanoids Daily report, says UBTECH Robotics of Shenzhen and the joint-venture carmaker FAW Volkswagen signed an agreement to test humanoid robots for factory logistics such as moving materials and sorting stock alongside human workers. It builds on earlier trials at FAW Volkswagen plants including Qingdao, and no order sizes or deployment dates were disclosed.
notes: Read Mjengo Hub copy; original Humanoids Daily not opened.
